events.title: Painting the Year of the Ram: Ink Painting on Canvas (Teens/Adults)

events.title: Protest and Politics in Turkey in the 70s
events.description: Protest and Politics in Turkey in the 1970s: Echoes of Dissent offers the first comprehensive academic study of Turkey's protest cycle during the 1970s.
events.blurb: Hear about the first comprehensive academic study of Turkey's 1970s protest cycle at this talk at Encina Commons.

events.title: L. Maria Bo, "Writing on Water: Cold War Literary Translations and the Chinese Diaspora," in conversation with Vaughn Rasberry
events.address: Center for Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CCSRE), 450 Jane Stanford Way Building 360, Stanford, CA 94305
events.description: During the Cold War, the ideological struggle to win the hearts and minds of the Chinese took place on the pages of literary texts.
events.blurb: Hear L. Maria Bo discuss Cold War literary translations and the Chinese diaspora, in conversation with Vaughn Rasberry.
